Introducing Magic Abstracts | Pattern Brushes and Stamps for Procreate

Unleash your creativity with the Magic Abstracts collection, created exclusively for Procreate.

Features:

42 Abstract Shapes Stamps: explore a diverse range of 42 stamps crafted to elevate your artwork effortlessly.
30 Abstract Pattern Brushes: fuel your imagination with a set of 30 seamless pattern brushes.
4 Bonus Texture Brushes: elevate your designs further with an exclusive set of 4 bonus texture brushes, each tailored to add depth and texture to your compositions.

Unleash Your Imagination:

Whether you’re a professional artist or just beginning your Procreate journey, Magic Abstracts empowers you to create awe-inspiring artwork with ease. Use abstract shapes in your designs, add patterns to craft visually stunning pieces that stand out.

Color Palettes: Bright Colorful Palette & Pastel Boho Colors are included in set to help you creating stunning work with a perfect matching colors.

Important Note: Make sure you read the PDF instructions before use.Redistribution or resale of the brushes, stamps, or patterns, either in their original form or slightly modified, is strictly prohibited. Seamless Patterns and Abstract Shapes permitted to be utilized for sale only as an integrated part of your original artwork.

Thank you for allowing Magic Abstracts to be a part of your artistic journey.
